candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey get convulsion now. Dem never get convulsion before. E no dey act like person wey weak or dey unconscious. Di pikin fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem no see any clouding for e cornea. Di fever don last two days. Di pikin get rash wey spread for body. Dem no identify bacterial cause for this assessment. This area na high malaria risk area. Malaria test dey available. Malaria test show negative. Di pikin dey cough as part of measles. Dem no see measles for di pikin for di last three months. Pikin no get mouth ulcer. Dem no see any obvious cause for di fever. Dem no see pus dey come out from e eye. Dem no see red eye. Dem no see catarrh. Di neck no stiff. Dem check temperature, e show 38.0°C. Di pikin na 18 months old. E no get cough or breathing wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E dey run fever.
